intro.title: Why choose Olympian Landscaping
paragraphs: We take great pride in our work and tackle every project with a can-do attitude. Our focus is always on quality of workmanship, customer service and affordability.

Owner Luke Doyle has worked on a broad range of projects throughout Ireland, Australia and Canada. Our team of skilled landscape gardeners and horticulturalists deals with every aspect of the garden, from planning and design to construction.
We work closely with our customers throughout a project and keep them informed as we go.
